def format_currency(n):
    if n < 0:
        sign = "-"
        n = -n
    else:
        sign = ""
    
    s = str(n)
    # Insert commas every 3 digits from the right
    if len(s) <= 3:
        formatted = s
    else:
        last_three = s[-3:]
        rest = s[:-3]
        # Group the rest into chunks of 3 from the right
        chunks = []
        while rest:
            if len(rest) <= 3:
                chunks.append(rest)
                break
            else:
                chunks.append(rest[-3:])
                rest = rest[:-3]
        chunks.reverse()
        formatted = ",".join(chunks) + "," + last_three
    
    return sign + "$" + formatted
```
